source_lines: SpawnMeshesToWorld(DataPath, materials, i, j) with `_Tile_i_j` name filter
SaveWorld(AssetData, PackageName, Map.Path, TileName): rename + SavePackage to DestPath/WorldName
input_assets: StaticMesh assets under post-MoveAssets canonical category trees, filtered by tile suffix
tile_coordinate_source: loop indices (i,j), NOT manifest (manifest tile list is not consulted by the loop)
precondition: meshes must already sit in canonical Static/ trees (MoveAssets must have run); TilesInfo.txt supplies only LargeMapManager offsets, not iteration bounds
offset_grid_consequence: 0-based probing stops at first empty tile; offset grids (6_6..10_9) yield zero worlds (see TILE_GENERATION_BLOCKED.json)
